tasks.prompt: Determine whether the OKF bundle in ./bundle is conformant. Return only JSON: {"answer": true|false, "evidence": "brief explanation"}.
Count the concepts in the OKF bundle in ./bundle. Return only JSON: {"answer": <integer>, "evidence": "brief explanation"}.
Count concepts by type in the OKF bundle in ./bundle. Return only JSON: {"answer": {"Ledger":1,"Record":2,"Service":3,"Spec":3}, "evidence": "brief explanation"}.
Identify every concept with no inbound link in the OKF bundle in ./bundle. Use short concept names. Return only JSON: {"answer": [<sorted names>], "evidence": "brief explanation"}.
Identify cycles in the link graph of the OKF bundle in ./bundle. Use short concept names. Return only JSON: {"answer": [[<cycle names>]], "evidence": "brief explanation"}.
Count unresolved links in the OKF bundle in ./bundle. Return only JSON: {"answer": <integer>, "evidence": "brief explanation"}.
Identify types in use that have no specification document in the OKF bundle in ./bundle. Return only JSON: {"answer": [<sorted type names>], "evidence": "brief explanation"}.

Determine which existing concepts are impacted if concept 'a' is deleted from the OKF bundle in ./bundle. Use short concept names and include transitive impact. Return only JSON: {"answer": [<sorted names>], "evidence": "brief explanation"}.
